thinggroups.description: Application-defined containers for WoT Thing Descriptions, Thing Models and Thing Projections. A Group can contain any mixture of kinds

things.description: A WoT document, served unchanged. Each Version holds one complete JSON-LD 1.1 document; kind distinguishes ThingDescription, ThingModel and ThingProjection

kind.name: kind
kind.description: The document kind. Required without a default and fixed across all Versions of this Resource. Stored as registry metadata, not inserted into the WoT document

format.name: format
format.description: The document format. All Versions of a Thing Resource share one format

wotid.name: wotid
wotid.description: The authored WoT identifier, equal to the document's id member where present, otherwise supplied by the Producer. Distinct from thingid. All Versions share one wotid; identity for kind-specific resolution is (kind, wotid)

derivedfrom.name: derivedfrom
derivedfrom.description: For ThingDescription and ThingModel only: the authored WoT identifiers of referenced Thing Models, not xids. This draft does not define ThingProjection lineage

license.name: license
license.description: The license the document is offered under, as an SPDX license expression or a URL. Advisory provenance metadata

publisher.name: publisher
publisher.description: The organization that published the document. Advisory provenance metadata

standardsbody.name: standardsbody
standardsbody.description: The standards organization that defines or endorses the document, where one does, for example 'W3C' or 'OPC Foundation'. Advisory provenance metadata

canonicalurl.name: canonicalurl
canonicalurl.description: The canonical upstream location of the document, where it is also published outside this registry. Advisory provenance metadata

maturity.name: maturity
maturity.description: How established the document is, letting a Consumer prefer an official definition over an ad hoc one. Advisory provenance metadata that does not affect the semantic identity of the document
